questions.cardText:
[Ecology] What is “biomagnification”?
A. The increase in the size of living organisms
B. The process through which biodiversity increases over time in nature
C. The increase in concentration of a substance in living organisms as it moves up the food chain
Answer: C.
questions.de: Wie heißt die Zunahme der Konzentration eines Stoffes wie DDT in Lebewesen auf jeweils höheren Stufen einer Nahrungskette?
questions.en: What is the term for the increase in concentration of a substance, such as DDT, in organisms at successively higher levels of a food chain?

timeline.labelEn: The US ban on DDT, a pesticide known to biomagnify, takes effect
timeline.labelDe: Das US-Verbot von DDT, einem sich in Nahrungsketten anreichernden Pestizid, tritt in Kraft

questions.notes: Card correct. Timeline: EPA 'DDT Ban Takes Effect' (1972-12-31), cited in the article.

questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] What is a teratoma?
A. A malignant tumor that only affects bone tissue
B. A benign tumor made up of a single type of tissue
C. Tumors of cells of more than one tissue type
Answer: C. Teratomas can contain a variety of tissue types, including hair, teeth, and even remnants of eyes and brains.
questions.de: Wie heißt ein Tumor aus mehreren Gewebearten, der Haare, Zähne oder sogar Knochen enthalten kann?
questions.en: What is the name of a tumour made up of several types of tissue, which can contain hair, teeth or even bone?

timeline.labelEn: Johannes Scultetus records the first well-documented teratoma, an ovarian dermoid cyst
timeline.labelDe: Johannes Scultetus beschreibt das erste gut dokumentierte Teratom, eine Dermoidzyste des Eierstocks

questions.notes: Card correct. Timeline (Scultetus 1659) from StatPearls via web search, not the source page; the term itself is usually credited to Virchow (1863).
